WITH invoice_stats AS (
  SELECT
    invoice_number,
    AVG(product_price) AS mean_line_item_price,
    COUNT(*) AS line_item_count
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
)
SELECT
  AVG(mean_line_item_price) AS average_of_invoice_mean_line_item_prices,
  AVG(line_item_count) AS average_line_items_per_invoice
FROM invoice_stats;
